rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a decline in function, strength, quality, or value.

example.english: The battery in this phone has clearly suffered degradation after years of use.
example.traditional: 呢部手機用咗幾年，電池明顯退化喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jung6 zo2 gei2 nin4 din6 ci4 ming4 hin2 teoi3 faa3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being lowered to a lower rank, grade, or social standing.

example.english: He will face degradation to a lower rank tomorrow for breaking the rules.
example.traditional: 佢犯咗規，聽日會被降級。
example.jyutping: keoi5 faan6 zo2 kwai1 ting1 jat6 wui5 bei6 gong3 kap1

rows.note: Use this when the lowering concerns someone’s character, reputation, or perceived worth rather than an official rank.

example.english: You don't need to subject yourself to such degradation; everyone makes mistakes.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁樣貶低自己，人人都有出錯嘅時候。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 joeng2 bin2 dai1 zi6 gei2 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 ceot1 co3 ge3 si4 hau6
